regime_read: The pack shows a broad AI/semiconductor/defense-tech convergence — AMAT, MSFT, NVDA, PLTR all carry independent-channel support — but most high-beta names are already extended, so the actionable edge sits in lagging or mean-reverting names (AMAT, MU, BA, MMC) plus one genuine multi-channel alignment in a non-extended mega-cap (MSFT). Track record is empty, so all conviction stays low.
regime_read_zh: 证据包显示AI/半导体/国防科技方向的广泛共振——AMAT、MSFT、NVDA、PLTR都有独立渠道支撑——但多数高贝塔标的已经超涨，可操作的边际机会集中在滞涨或均值回归的名字（AMAT、MU、BA、MMC），以及一个非超涨巨头的真多渠道路径（MSFT）。暂无历史战绩，所有置信度保持低位。

theses.thesis: Six independent channels fire simultaneously — affiliation (Altman PARTNERS_WITH, Ackman AFFILIATES_WITH), app_demand (4.77 rating, 28.4M 30d downloads), cnbc_pick, github_momentum (192,888 stars), patent_cluster (491 patents), and trump buy-side link — with $1.73B disclosed congressional positioning behind it. This is one of the few names in the pack where convergence does not come with an extended chart (rs_vs_spy_60d +30.7pp, below the +35pp chase threshold). The OpenAI/Ackman connectivity implies enterprise AI spend and regulatory-adjacent tailwinds land here first.
theses.thesis_zh: 六个独立渠道同时触发——关联关系（Altman合作、Ackman关联）、应用需求（4.77分、30天2840万下载）、CNBC推荐、GitHub动能（192,888星）、专利集群（491项）、特朗普买方关联，且背后有17.3亿美元已披露的国会持仓。这是证据包中少数共振却不超涨的名字（60日相对SPY +30.7pp，低于+35pp追高阈值）。OpenAI/Ackman的关联意味着企业AI支出与监管邻近顺风首先落在此处。
second_order: NVDA — the other AI compute backbone alongside MSFT's Azure/OpenAI buildout, with Pelosi/McCaul congressional stakes echoing the AI-infra trade
ORCL — large public-cloud beneficiary not in pack, implied by Altman PARTNERS_WITH (OpenAI's Oracle partnership)
ANET — AI datacenter networking beneficiary, implied by Microsoft/Azure hyperscaler capex
theses.dissent: The trump link is a soft sentiment channel, and the app/github strength has been persistent for quarters — this may already be the crowd consensus rather than new edge.

falsifier.text: 30d app downloads or github star velocity decelerates meaningfully while the stock retests its 60d relative high

theses.thesis: AMAT is the clearest laggard in the pack: hard rs_vs_spy_60d of -37.3pp while five channels fire — analyst_upgrade_cluster (0.97 bull ratio), congress_cluster (4 members, $52.6M net buy), news_sentiment (0.86 bull), patent_cluster (293), and unusual_options (put/call 1.07 with 0.611 vol/OI suggesting active positioning). Congress is buying semis into a sell-off, and the Memory Chip Competitiveness Assessment Act pending in the House adds a direct catalyst.
theses.thesis_zh: AMAT是证据包中最清晰的滞涨标的：60日相对SPY -37.3pp，同时五个渠道触发——分析师上调集群（0.97看多比）、国会集群（4名议员、5260万美元净买入）、新闻情绪（0.86看多）、专利集群（293项）、异常期权（put/call 1.07，vol/OI 0.611暗示活跃建仓）。国会在回调中买入半导体，众议院待审的《存储芯片竞争力评估法案》又提供直接催化剂。
second_order: MU — direct memory-chip peer named by the same pending legislation, also lagging at -9.4pp
LRCX — closest process-equipment peer, the other major beneficiary of advanced-memory capex
KLAC — inspection/metrology companion to AMAT's deposition and etch install base
evidence: bill_catalyst: Memory Chip Competitiveness Assessment Act, HR10170
theses.dissent: A -37pp relative spread can signal a genuine fundamental problem rather than mispricing; four congress members buying is a small sample and could be routine diversification.

falsifier.text: Congress discloses a net sell in a subsequent filing or the memory-chip bill dies in committee

theses.thesis: MU has an earnings catalyst five days out (2026-09-30, 18.6% historical surprise) plus affiliation (Ro Khanna), insider_mspr at 100, patent_cluster (446), and a maxed stocktwits bull ratio. The House memory-chip bill pending on the calendar gives a policy tailwind alongside AMAT. It is not extended (-9.4pp), making it one of the few actionable non-chase names in the pack.
theses.thesis_zh: MU有一个五天后到期的财报催化剂（2026-09-30，历史超预期18.6%），叠加关联关系（Ro Khanna）、内部人买入信号100、专利集群（446项）和满配的Stocktwits看多比。众议院待审的存储芯片法案与AMAT形成同一政策顺风。未超涨（-9.4pp），是证据包中少数可操作且无需追高的名字。
second_order: AMAT — upstream capital equipment supplier riding the same memory-capex bill
WDC — secondary memory beneficiary if DRAM/NAND pricing inflects on MU's print
evidence: bill_catalyst: Memory Chip Competitiveness Assessment Act
theses.dissent: Playing a binary earnings event five days out on signal that includes retail-buzz noise (stocktwits 1.0) is essentially a coin flip on the print itself.

falsifier.text: MU guides next-quarter memory pricing or bit growth below the whisper while memory peers re-rate lower

theses.thesis: MMC is the cleanest non-extended gov-contract acceleration story in the pack: gov_contract_accel of 22.96 with $26.8M bookings in 30d, plus news_sentiment at 0.92 and an earnings catalyst 20 days out. As a defense/risk-consulting operator, it sits near the border/fraud-enforcement and DOJ Fraud Division bills on the calendar (HRES1530, HR10326), an under-appreciated legislative tailwind.
theses.thesis_zh: MMC是证据包中最干净的非超涨政府合同加速标的：gov_contract_accel 22.96，30天订单2680万美元，新闻情绪0.92，且20天后有财报催化剂。作为国防/风险咨询运营商，它紧邻日程上的边境/反舞弊执法和DOJ反舞弊部门法案（HRES1530、HR10326），是一个被低估的立法顺风。
second_order: BAE — defense contractor exposed to the same federal enforcement/infrastructure spend
PLTR — government software adjacency, though its chart is extended and should not be chased here
theses.dissent: A 22.96 acceleration reading can be a one-off contract lump rather than a trend; MMC's 2.8% earnings surprise history suggests no structural momentum on the event itself.

falsifier.text: Q3 federal bookings or the government-services backlog comes in below the acceleration implied by the 30d print

theses.thesis: BA's cluster is thinner but non-extended (-12.1pp): affiliation, gov_grant inflow of $7.8M, patent_cluster (231), and a 0.92 stocktwits bull ratio with Cramer ENDORSES as a soft actor link. The pending Water Resources Development Act and defense-property transfer bill give a mild infrastructure/defense tailwind, and a poorly positioned chart into that is the only reason it earns a read.
theses.thesis_zh: BA的集群较薄但未超涨（-12.1pp）：关联关系、政府拨款流入780万美元、专利集群（231项）、0.92的Stocktwits看多比，以及Cramer背书这一软性关联。待审的《水资源开发法案》和国防资产移交法案给出温和的基建/国防顺风，且当前偏弱的图表位置是唯一值得一读的原因。
second_order: HON — diversified aerospace/defense supplier benefiting from the same infra/defense approvals
RTX — defense prime with similar federal-procurement exposure
theses.dissent: Cramer endorsement as a bearish-fade signal is the strongest contrary tell this name has; the gov_grant is too small to matter for a company of BA's size.

falsifier.text: The Cramer-linked retail bid fades and the stock loses its -12pp relative floor, confirming the track was sentiment-only
